note: Pinned inputs for the obake Buildroot image build. This file is the single source of truth for the Buildroot release, the realtime kernel source, and the vendored EFI stub; build.sh verifies the Buildroot and kernel hashes before building. Bumping a pin and rebuilding is the only way the base changes.

efi_stub.note: systemd EFI stub used to build the per-slot unified kernel images. Buildroot builds an aarch64 stub only for x86_64 targets, so the aarch64 stub is built once from the pinned systemd source and vendored under vendor/efi-stub/; the x86_64 stub is produced in-tree (BR2_PACKAGE_SYSTEMD_BOOT).
